description:
Signs an existing Google player in by exchanging one fresh authorization code for a player session.
Use when: a known Google player completes OAuth and requests signin.
Not for: an unknown/new player: use horizon_signup_google with signInIfExists=true for one-click registration/signin instead of probing with this tool.
Side effects: exchanges the Google code once and creates a session; no automatic signup, retries or provider UI.
Returns: user details, authStatus: AUTHENTICATED and accessToken, plus refreshToken and both expiry timestamps only with includeRefreshToken=true.
Errors: 404 USER_NOT_FOUND requires a fresh OAuth code before signup. Never reuse this code after an error or lost response. 400 for invalid provider data, 403 for an unavailable user. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

googleAuthorizationCode.description: Fresh single-use Google authorization code obtained by the player's OAuth consent flow (max 2000 characters)

googleRedirectUri.description: Exact redirect URI used to obtain the Google authorization code; empty string for configured native flows (max 500 characters)

includeRefreshToken.description: Explicit opt-in to a rotating 30-day refresh session; omitted or false preserves access-only behavior. Store refresh tokens in platform secure storage

name: horizon_signin_google
title: Sign In with Google
